name: game-network-a1b
description: Step A1b of docs/design/game-reconstruction-and-motion.md on the Arc 140T (an Intel GPU whose driver lists 8x8x16 with fp32 accumulators and no 8x16x16 fp16 shape): Ocarina of Time's own network in software (the baseline), on 8x8x16 cooperative matrices (EDEN_NX2_INTEL_COOP_MATRIX_8X8) and on them with EDEN_NX2_HMMA_ZERO_C. The network runs in every variant: game presets off, anti-aliasing Game, frame generation off, the Max Resolution add-on on (its default). EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_LOG=1 logs the path each tensor program takes. The cost to compare is the output pass's GPU time in each row's gpu_costs (work, shader 6bd913e1f34e83eb). A matrix row counts only when its log has the EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_LOG line for that shader naming the 8x8x16 path and no 'anti-aliasing network bypassed' line; the software row needs the line with the software path. Every arm translates the network afresh: run the suite twice in one session and read only the second pass, comparing its two software rows first.
